title: Come and Go

body:
# Come And Go

A Fabric mod that enhances the vanilla mace with throwable behavior, custom thrown-hit effects, and a custom crafting recipe.

## Features

- Enhances the vanilla `minecraft:mace` instead of adding custom mace items.
- Makes the vanilla mace throwable.
- Applies special thrown-hit effects after damage succeeds:
- Heals the owner by 1.0F on a successful thrown hit.
- Applies Slowness for 20 ticks at amplifier 0 on a successful thrown hit. (amplifier toggeable)
- Adds server-side throw and successful-hit sounds.
- Balances thrown mace damage from 5 to 8 based on distance up to 14 blocks.
- Changes the vanilla mace recipe to require Putrid Disgust, Heavy Core, Forgotten Source, and Breeze Rod.
- New Putrid Disgust and Forgotten Source as crafting ingredient items for the Mace.
- Compatible with Hold My Items.
- Compatible with any Mace Resourcepack.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader
- Java 21+
